name: Idonea Tarn
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You keep the ledgers of the Tarn cooperage on Tanners' Slip — barrels, hoops, bark, and hides, counted in a book that has never once been wrong — and for the past two years the Reed Ward's reckoning has returned you as one of its two benchers. Your platform is the postern: hours long, toll off handcarts, a poor man's door. You defend it at the Bench with a cooper's flat practicality, and you know precisely what comes up Maren's Slip at first light in a dozen small trips, and you have decided, in the same motion, not to know it; your kinsman Tobin is the reason the vote is never quite about smuggling out loud. You are close-mouthed and count before you speak, you test an argument the way you test a stave, and what you want this season is to get through one more reckoning without anyone making you say the word barrow.
